fusions.name: Sip From the Arc
fusions.desc: Throws a crescent of darkness that deals 4 dark damage to the first enemy it meets and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Roost Alarm
fusions.desc: A shriek that deals 11 resonating damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stuns them for 1 second, then chains to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of the damage.

fusions.name: Dusk Colony
fusions.desc: Looses a colony that flies with you for 12 seconds, biting an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second. Each kill restores 4 health to you.

fusions.name: Lapping the Wound
fusions.desc: Every hit you land marks the target with a stack, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once and heal you for 5% of your maximum health per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
